# FairDraw

> FairDraw is a verifiable giveaway and growth platform for X (Twitter). Organisers set a prize pool and entry conditions; FairDraw imports replies, checks eligibility, draws winners with a deterministic SHA-256-seeded algorithm (open source at src/lib/draw.ts), and publishes results anyone can recompute in the browser. Payouts are published as on-chain tx hashes or receipts.

## Key facts
- Prize pools are escrowed: organisers fund upfront, unmet conditions trigger 100% refunds, drawn pools lock for payouts.
- Fees are tiered by pool amount (live tiers on the launch page and Terms), no other charges.
- Deposits accept USDT/USDC on BNB Chain, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum and X Layer. On-chain-funded pools pay winners USDT on BNB Smart Chain (network fee covered); card-funded pools pay an equal-value gift card by email; manual pools are paid directly by the organiser.
- Candidate list + seed are public; the draw algorithm is open source at https://github.com/lonzo-huang/fairdraw/blob/main/src/lib/draw.ts — results are recomputable client-side.
- Official X account: https://x.com/FairDraw
- FairDraw is not affiliated with X (Twitter).

The site is bilingual: Chinese (default) and English.
